payload.question: What plumb tells the coding agent, by condition (the owner sees none of this; it is text for the agent): (1) session start, resume, or after the conversation was compacted: the intent being worked on in one line (its title, the loop's step, what is left), the questions waiting, the open known issues, the records changed since the agent last saw them; (2) each message: the records the request touches, new or changed since last shown; the intent being worked on when the message does not say it; another branch changing the same record; (3) an edit of a file: the requirement and examples that file serves and the tests that cover it, plus the links the edit made stale; (4) a test fails: whether it is a regression on confirmed behaviour or a test that never passed, and which example it proves; (5) the agent reports a symptom that matches a known issue: the known issue, its fix or its workaround; (6) before a commit or merge: what would hold it; (7) turn end: the one next action, as agreed; (8) a plumb check was cut short or a judge is unreachable: which step was skipped, once. Each said once per session per state, never repeated, nothing when nothing applies. Is this the set?
